notes.title: Updated control
notes.content:
- Added a tooltip for pages in the "Diary"

[h2]Added additional control buttons, in addition to the existing ones:[/h2]
- Running - "Shift" or "Space"
- Purchase in the store - "E" or "Enter"
- Scroll through dialogs - "E" or "Enter" or "Space"
- Exit from all game interfaces - "ESC"

And other small fixes :)
